prompts.counter:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent raster combat VFX for AXO Arena, a crypto degen axolotl game.
Primary request: a single compact counterattack effect: a strong curved return arrow made of luminous magenta and icy cyan energy, ricocheting off a small fractured diamond shield, with a few broken candlestick chart shards. The return direction must read instantly as a reversal, not as a shield dome or an explosion.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted game VFX with street graffiti edge, crisp chunky silhouette, luminous core, restrained spray speckles. Original art, no existing characters or logos.
Composition/framing: square, centered, one open curved arrow shape with broad transparent negative space around and inside it; safe transparent margins, designed to be legible at 140 pixels. No scene, no character, no opaque backdrop.
Text: none.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no black rectangle, no UI, no watermark, no dense fog or full-screen particles.
prompts.liquidation:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent raster graffiti decal for AXO Arena's late-exchange training panel.
Primary request: a witty crypto degen danger sticker: a red descending candlestick chart crashing into a cracked golden gas can, encircled by orange hazard tape and a small melting diamond. A clear bold hand-painted caption reads exactly "LIQUIDATED". Express high-stakes absurdity without money or gambling promises.
Style/medium: original premium game street-art sticker, paint-marker outlines, red-orange neon accents, black ink shading, modest cyan highlight; gritty but readable.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 compact single sticker, all parts in frame, safe transparent margin, readable caption at small size. No scene or character.
Constraints: actual transparent background, no white or black rectangular backdrop, no third-party logos, no watermark, no other text.
